description: This file is a header (.h) file for a C/C++ project that defines API functions and enumerations related to resolving data model paths within a software system. It includes function declarations, configuration macros, type definitions, and detailed comments explaining the purpose of each component, focusing on resolving paths, objects, and parameters.

methods.name: PATH_RESOLVER_ResolveDevicePath

methods.name: PATH_RESOLVER_ResolvePath
methods.description: Resolves a generic path based on specified parameters, including resolution operation, depth, role, and flags.

methods.name: PATH_RESOLVER_ValidatePath
methods.description: Validates whether a given path string is syntactically correct based on notification type.

methods.name: PATH_RESOLVER_AttachErrVector
methods.description: Attaches an error vector to a string vector for error reporting.
